title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
Pershore
Full-time - permanent
£30,000p/a - £35,000p/a

Job Summary
We are seeking a diligent and detail-oriented Credit Controller to join our clients finance team. The Credit Controller will play an essential role in managing and maintaining the company's credit and collections processes, ensuring timely payments, minimising overdue balances, and fostering strong relationships with clients.
This role is essential to maintaining healthy cash flow for the business.
The successful candidate will have previous accounting or finance experience, enabling them to identify discrepancies, investigate account issues, recognise potential risks, and proactively resolve problems before they impact the business.

Key Responsibilities
Credit Management
- Establish and maintain strong internal and external relationships to ensure effective credit management.
- Strong organisation and co-ordination skills ensuring agreed timelines are met.
- Excellent communication skills for dealing with internal and external partners.
- Ability to work across various platforms and systems.
- Reporting to management team on all client accounts.
- Providing insights and recommendations on improving collections processes.
- Reviewing account activity and financial data to identify trends, anomalies, or potential payment issues.
- Investigating and resolving account discrepancies in collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders.

Key Skills and Competencies
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
- High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Proficiency in various software systems.
- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines under pressure.
- Knowledge of credit control practices and financial regulations.
- Previous accounting or finance experience with the ability to analyse account information, identify discrepancies, and proactively resolve issues.
- A sound understanding of accounting principles and the impact of credit control on overall business cash flow and financial performance.

This is a full time permanent position with a salary of £30,000 - £35,000p/a.

For more information on this position please contact Harriet at Four Squared Recruitment.

If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We thank you for your interest and encourage you to apply for future opportunities.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Temporary Finance Assistant to join a busy finance team based in Pershore.

The role will be primarily focused on invoicing, but will also involve a range of other finance and administrative duties, making this a great opportunity for someone with previous finance experience who enjoys a varied role.

Key Responsibilities
Processing and raising invoices accurately and efficiently.
Checking invoices and supporting documentation before processing.
Investigating and resolving invoicing queries.
Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring information is kept up to date.
Assisting with reconciliations and other routine finance duties.
Supporting the wider Finance team with day-to-day tasks.
Responding to internal and external finance queries.
Assisting with month-end activities where required.
Providing general administrative support to the Finance function.
Completing ad hoc finance duties as required.
About You

The ideal candidate will have:

Previous experience within a finance or accounts environment.
Good experience of invoicing.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good numerical skills.
Experience using Excel and finance/accounting systems.
Good organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
Strong communication skills.
A proactive and reliable approach to work.
The ability to work independently as well as part of a wider finance team.
The Opportunity

This is a temporary position based in Pershore, offering the opportunity to join an established Finance team and gain experience across a range of finance activities.

If you have solid invoicing experience and are available for a temporary opportunity, we would be keen to hear from you.

You will be based onsite for 5 days a week with hours of 830am-5pm. For the right person this role may be temporary - permanent

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Temporary opportunity to work in Redditch on a temporary to permanent role for the right person. It will be working for a well-established, engineering-led business and the role is a Finance assistant position with a sales ledger and month end bias

You'll be responsible for managing the sales ledger, maintaining robust credit controls, leading cash collection, preparing weekly cash flow forecasts, and producing detailed sales and margin analysis for management reporting. The ideal candidate will be both hands-on and commercially astute, with the ability to build effective relationships across finance, operations, and sales.

Key Responsibilities:
Full ownership of credit control and sales ledger maintenance

Posting receipts, managing aged debt, and resolving queries efficiently

Weekly cash flow forecasting and monthly intercompany reconciliations

Bank reconciliations and support with month-end close

Sales analysis including cost of sales and margin variance by area

Maintaining accurate credit account records and processing new applications

Liaising with internal stakeholders and customers to ensure smooth operations

You'll Need:
Solid experience in a credit control/sales ledger position (ideally sole charge or minimal supervision)

Strong Excel skills; experience with SAP is advantageous

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills - calm, assertive, and professional

A proactive, problem-solving mindset and high attention to detail

Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
As an Accounts Assistant in Redditch, you'll play a key role in keeping the accounting and finance operations running smoothly. From managing credit control to supporting general accounts tasks, your work will help ensure the business stays on top of its financial commitments.

This company operates within the industrial and manufacturing industry and is based in Redditch.

Description

The Accounts Assistant will;
- Manage and monitor customer credit accounts to ensure timely payments.
- Process invoices and maintain accurate financial records.
- Assist with reconciliations and resolving discrepancies.
- Support the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Communicate with customers regarding overdue accounts and payment plans.
- Collaborate with the finance team to improve processes and efficiency.
- Handle queries and provide assistance with general accounting tasks.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and financial regulations.

Profile

A successful Accounts Assistant should have:
- Experience in credit control and general accounting tasks.
- A good understanding of financial processes and practices.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency in relevant accounting software and tools.
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

- Hourly pay ranging from £18.00 to £22.00, dependent on the level of experience.
- Temporary contract offering flexibility.
- Fully on site role

title: Paralegal - Commercial Litigation
description:
Litigation Paralegal

Bromsgrove, Worcestershire £27,000 Hybrid Permanent

A growing Worcestershire law firm is looking to add a Litigation Paralegal to its expanding disputes team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with some existing litigation or disputes experience who is looking for a role where they can broaden their experience, work closely with experienced lawyers and build towards the next stage of their career.

The team handles a varied range of commercial and financial disputes, meaning you'll gain exposure to a broad caseload rather than being limited to one particular area.

What you'll be doing

You'll support the team across a varied portfolio of matters, including:
- Commercial and contractual disputes
- Financial and banking litigation
- Employment-related disputes
- Debt recovery
- Business and commercial claims
- Civil litigation and dispute resolution

You'll have plenty of opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, take on increasing responsibility and learn from experienced fee earners around you.

Why consider the role?

The firm is committed to developing people from within, with genuine opportunities to progress as your experience grows.

It could be particularly well suited to someone who has started their career in litigation and is now looking for a firm where they can establish themselves long term, with potential opportunities to progress towards qualification.

What are they looking for?

The key requirement is some relevant litigation or disputes experience and a genuine interest in developing within the area.

Your background could include:
- Litigation or disputes paralegal experience
- Civil litigation or debt recovery
- Commercial disputes
- A relevant legal graduate/LPC/SQE background with practical experience
- Another role providing exposure to contentious legal work

You certainly don't need to have experience across every area listed above - attitude, willingness to learn and a genuine interest in litigation are just as important.

If you're looking for a role where you can build your litigation experience, work on varied matters and develop within a supportive team, this could be a great next step.

Apply now or get in touch for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Wedding & Events Co-ordinator
description:
Wedding & Events Co-ordinator

Worcestershire

Permanent

£28,000 - £35,000 + Bonus

An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an ambitious, organised and customer-focused Wedding & Events Coordinator to join a highly respected and established events and hospitality business based in Worcestershire.

This is far more than a traditional events role. It offers the chance to be involved in the planning, coordination and delivery of a diverse range of memorable experiences, from luxury weddings and private celebrations to corporate events and bespoke catering functions.

Working within a passionate and supportive team, you will play a pivotal role in bringing clients' visions to life, guiding them through every stage of their journey from initial enquiry and venue viewing through to seamless event execution. You'll be responsible for creating unforgettable experiences, building lasting relationships with clients and suppliers, and ensuring every event is delivered to the highest possible standard.

No two days are the same. One day you could be conducting venue tours with prospective couples, the next coordinating suppliers, overseeing event set-ups, creating engaging social media content, or managing the smooth delivery of a stunning wedding or large-scale private function. This is a hands-on role that combines event planning, client relationship management, operational coordination, hospitality and marketing, making it an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and rewarding environment.

The business operates across a seven-day events schedule, meaning flexibility is essential. In return, you'll join a successful and growing organisation known for delivering exceptional customer experiences, offering genuine career development opportunities, a collaborative team culture and the chance to be part of some truly special occasions.

Working Hours
- 5-day rota working pattern
- Typically 9-10 days off per month
- Frequent weekend working required
- Event days generally start between 9am and 10am and finish in the early evening
- Occasional evening and late-night event cover may be required
- Additional support may be required during peak wedding season

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000 - £35,000 depending on experience
- Paid overtime
- Performance-related bonuses
- Company pension scheme
- Free on-site parking
- Company laptop provided
- Meals provided during shifts where applicable
- Company social events
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Genuine long-term career opportunity within a growing business

Key Responsibilities
- Manage wedding and event enquiries from initial contact through to final planning meetings
- Conduct venue show-rounds and convert enquiries into bookings
- Liaise with suppliers including florists, DJs, entertainers and venue partners
- Coordinate all event logistics and client requirements
- Oversee event setup, including room layouts, décor and equipment
- Manage and support operational staff during events
- Ensure venue presentation and cleanliness standards are maintained
- Create engaging marketing content for social media and online platforms
- Support catering operations, including order processing and event logistics
- Assist with promotional activities and business development initiatives

About You

The ideal candidate will possess:
- Previous experience within weddings, events, hospitality or venue management
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent communication and customer service abilities
- Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive and adaptable attitude
- Confidence working independently and as part of a team
- Knowledge of social media platforms, including Instagram and TikTok
- Ability to remain calm under pressure during busy event periods

Requirements
- Experience within hospitality, events or a customer-facing environment
- Full driving licence and access to a vehicle due to the rural location
- Flexibility to work weekends as part of a rota
- Availability during peak wedding and events seasons

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about creating memorable experiences and developing a long-term career within the events and hospitality industry.

Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.

Thank you for taking the time to apply.

For more information on this position, please contact James Randall at Four Squared Recruitment.

title: Receptionist/Admin
description: The GP receptionist is responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and providing support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties may include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of personal information and assisting patients as required. To act as a central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with the multidisciplinary team member and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The core responsibilities of the receptionist are as follows. On occasion, there may be a requirement to carry out tasks not listed below, that are within the reasonable scope of the role. Maintain and monitor practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments Answer incoming phone calls, dealing with the callers request appropriately Signpost patients to the correct service Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as requested Input data as necessary onto patients healthcare records Direct requests for information to relevant team members i.e., SAR, DVLA forms, insurance/solicitors letters Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner Carry out system searches as requested Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required Photocopy documentation as required Maintain a clean, tidy and effective working area Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards Action incoming emails and correspondence as necessary Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the rota Support admin team, providing cover during absences Scan patient related documents and attach scanned documents to patients healthcare record This role will be for 16 hours on a Monday, Thursday and Friday afternoon, These are non-negotiable. Additonal hours for over time/cover may be worked between 08:00 and 18:30, Monday to Friday and occassional Saturdays 09:00 to 13:00
